format: TypeScript (TSX syntax for React-like components with Qwik framework)
description: This file defines the main frontend components of a personal notes organizer web application, including UI components like AuthModal, Navbar, Sidebar, NotesListPanel, NoteEditor, and the main application container NotesAppMain. It manages application state, user authentication, folder and note data, and rendering logic using Qwik framework constructs.

methods.name: AuthModal
methods.description: Component for user login/signup modal UI.

methods.name: Navbar
methods.description: Component for displaying app title and user logout button.

methods.name: Sidebar
methods.description: Component for displaying folders list, adding folders.

methods.name: NotesListPanel
methods.description: Component for listing notes and searching.

methods.name: NoteEditor
methods.description: Component for viewing, editing, saving, and deleting notes.

methods.name: NotesAppMain
methods.description: Main application component managing layout, state, and data flow.
